title: Novena to St. Anthony of Padua
description: A nine-day prayer to St. Anthony, the Wonder-Worker and finder of lost things. Known for his powerful intercession in helping people find what they have lost - both material items and spiritual direction in life.
intention: For finding lost objects, guidance in life decisions, assistance in difficulties, and miraculous help in seemingly impossible situations
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days when you need St. Anthony's help in finding something lost, making important decisions, or facing difficult situations. St. Anthony is known as the 'Wonder-Worker' for his powerful intercession. Many people include a small offering to charity when their prayer is answered, as a way of thanking St. Anthony.
background_info: St. Anthony of Padua (1195-1231) was a Portuguese Franciscan friar and Doctor of the Church. Despite dying at only 36, he was renowned for his powerful preaching, deep theological knowledge, and miraculous healing powers. He was canonized just one year after his death. He became associated with finding lost items through various legends, including one where he helped recover a stolen book of psalms. His feast day is one of the most popular in the Catholic calendar.

days.title: Day 1: Trust in St. Anthony's Intercession
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Blessed St. Anthony, the Wonder-Worker, you were blessed by God with the gift of working miracles. Time and time again, when people have come to you in their need, you have obtained for them the help of Almighty God. You have made the lame walk, given sight to the blind, speech to the dumb, and hearing to the deaf. Even inanimate objects have obeyed your word. I come to you today with complete confidence in your power with God. You know my need even before I express it, but I want to tell you that [mention your request]. I know that God loves me and that you want to help me in my need. I promise to be grateful for your intercession and to honor you always as my special patron and protector. Help me, St. Anthony, and let me experience the joy of having my prayer answered. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's reputation as a wonder-worker comes from his deep faith and complete trust in God's power. When we approach him with similar faith, we open ourselves to experience God's miraculous intervention in our lives through his intercession.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, I place my trust in your powerful intercession. Help me to have faith like yours and to trust completely in God's providence.
days.scripture: "If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer." - Matthew 21:22

days.title: Day 2: Finding What Is Lost
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, beloved of God and honored by the Church as the finder of lost articles, I come to you today because I have lost something important to me. You understand the anxiety and frustration that comes from losing something valuable or necessary. Your own book of psalms was once stolen, and through your prayers, it was returned to you. I ask you to help me find what I have lost [mention specific item or situation]. But more than material things, I also ask you to help me find my way when I feel lost in life, confused about decisions, or uncertain about God's will for me. Sometimes the most important things we lose are not objects but our sense of direction, our peace of mind, or our closeness to God. Help me to find not only what I have lost materially, but also to find clarity, purpose, and the path that leads to happiness and holiness. St. Anthony, you who found your way to God through a life of prayer and service, help me to find my way too. Amen.
days.reflection: While St. Anthony is famous for helping people find lost objects, his greatest help is in finding spiritual direction. Often what we have truly 'lost' is our sense of purpose, our peace, or our connection with God. St. Anthony can help us find these treasures too.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, help me to find what I have lost, both material and spiritual. Guide me to discover what is truly important in life.
days.scripture: "Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you." - Matthew 7:7

days.title: Day 3: Wisdom and Knowledge
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, Doctor of the Church, you were gifted with extraordinary wisdom and knowledge. Your understanding of Scripture was so profound that you were called the 'Ark of the Covenant' and the 'Living Book of Scripture.' You could explain the most difficult passages and make complex truths understandable to simple people. I ask you today to intercede for me, that I may grow in wisdom and knowledge, especially in understanding God's will for my life. Help me to make wise decisions and to see situations clearly with the light of truth. When I am confused or uncertain, guide my thoughts and help me to distinguish between what is truly important and what is merely superficial. Grant me the gift of good judgment and the ability to learn from my experiences. Help me to be wise in my relationships, prudent in my choices, and understanding in my dealings with others. Most of all, help me to grow in knowledge and love of God, who is the source of all wisdom. St. Anthony, share with me some of the wisdom that made you such a powerful preacher and teacher. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's great learning was always directed toward loving and serving God better. True wisdom is not just knowledge of facts, but understanding how to live well and make choices that lead to happiness and holiness.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, help me to grow in wisdom and to make decisions that honor God and lead to true happiness.
days.scripture: "If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you." - James 1:5

days.title: Day 4: Help in Difficulties
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, helper of all who call upon you, I come to you in my time of difficulty and distress. Life has presented me with challenges that seem overwhelming, problems that appear to have no solution, and burdens that feel too heavy to bear. You who worked so many miracles during your lifetime continue to help those who invoke your aid. I believe that God has given you special power to assist people in their troubles and to provide solutions when human efforts seem insufficient. I lay before you all my difficulties [mention specific problems], trusting that you will present my needs to God and obtain for me the help I so desperately need. Help me to face my challenges with courage and to find practical solutions to my problems. When I am tempted to despair, remind me that with God's help, no situation is truly hopeless. Give me strength to persevere, wisdom to know what steps to take, and peace to accept what cannot be changed. St. Anthony, you who are called the Wonder-Worker, work a wonder in my life by helping me overcome these difficulties. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's miracles often involved helping people in seemingly impossible situations. His intercession reminds us that God's power is greater than any difficulty we face, and that there is always hope when we turn to Him in prayer.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, intercede for me in my difficulties. Help me to trust in God's power to resolve what seems impossible.
days.scripture: "I can do all this through him who gives me strength." - Philippians 4:13

days.title: Day 5: Protection and Safety
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, powerful protector and guardian, I place myself and my loved ones under your special protection. During your life on earth, you protected the innocent, defended the poor, and stood up against those who would harm the vulnerable. Your very presence brought safety and peace to those around you. I ask you to watch over me and those I love. Protect us from physical harm, accidents, and danger. Guard us against the spiritual dangers of temptation, sin, and evil influences. Be our shield in times of trouble and our strength when we feel afraid. I especially ask your protection for [mention specific people or situations]. Keep us safe in our travels, secure in our homes, and peaceful in our hearts. Help us to trust in God's providence while also being wise and prudent in avoiding unnecessary risks. When we face uncertainty or feel threatened, remind us that we are not alone - that you are watching over us and that God's angels are protecting us. St. Anthony, be our guardian and guide, leading us safely through all the dangers of this life to our eternal home in heaven. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's protection extends beyond physical safety to include spiritual protection. He helps guard us against the spiritual dangers that threaten our souls and guides us away from situations that could harm our relationship with God.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, be my protector and guardian. Keep me and my loved ones safe from all harm, both physical and spiritual.
days.scripture: "For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11

days.title: Day 6: Healing and Health
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, instrument of God's healing power, during your lifetime you restored health to countless people who came to you in faith. The lame walked, the blind received sight, and the sick were made whole through your prayers and touch. I come to you today asking for your intercession for healing - for myself and for all who are suffering from illness, disease, or infirmity. You know the pain and anxiety that comes with poor health, and you understand how illness affects not only the body but also the mind and spirit. I ask you to pray for [mention specific health concerns], that God may grant healing according to His will. But I also ask for healing of a deeper kind - healing of relationships that have been broken, healing of emotional wounds that have not yet closed, healing of spiritual ailments that keep me from growing closer to God. Help me to be patient with the process of healing and to trust in God's timing. If physical healing is not granted, help me to find meaning in my suffering and to unite it with the sufferings of Christ. St. Anthony, great healer, touch my life with God's healing power. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's healing miracles remind us that God cares about our physical wellbeing, but they also point to the deeper healing that our souls need. Sometimes our greatest healing comes not from the removal of suffering but from finding meaning and grace within it.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, pray for healing in my life and in the lives of all who suffer. Help us to trust in God's love even in times of illness.
days.scripture: "Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those who have leprosy, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give." - Matthew 10:8

days.title: Day 7: Financial Needs and Provision
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, patron of the poor and helper of those in need, you understood what it meant to depend entirely on God's providence. As a Franciscan, you embraced poverty and trusted completely in God's care. Yet you also knew that people have legitimate material needs and that God wants to provide for His children. I come to you today with my financial concerns and material needs. I ask your intercession for [mention specific financial needs or work situations]. Help me to find honest work that provides for my needs and allows me to use my talents in service of others. Guide me to make wise financial decisions and to be responsible with the resources God has given me. Teach me to be generous with others, especially those who have less than I do, even when my own resources seem limited. Help me to find the proper balance between working diligently to provide for myself and my family while also trusting in God's providence. When I am tempted to worry excessively about money or to pursue wealth for its own sake, remind me that my true treasure is in heaven. St. Anthony, you who trusted completely in God's care, help me to have that same trust while also doing my part to meet my responsibilities. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's relationship with poverty was not about neglecting practical needs but about trusting that God would provide what was truly necessary. He teaches us to work diligently while also maintaining proper priorities about material things.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, help me to trust in God's providence for my material needs while also being responsible and generous with what I have.
days.scripture: "And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus." - Philippians 4:19

days.title: Day 8: Family and Relationships
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, you who brought peace and reconciliation wherever you went, I ask your intercession for my family and all my relationships. Help me to be a source of harmony and understanding in my family, and help my family members to love and support one another. Where there has been misunderstanding, bring clarity. Where there has been hurt, bring healing. Where there has been distance, bring closeness. I pray especially for [mention specific family members or relationship concerns]. Help us to forgive one another when we have caused pain, to be patient with each other's faults, and to celebrate each other's joys. Guide single people in finding good companions and help married couples to grow in love and faithfulness. Protect children from harm and help parents to raise them with wisdom and love. Heal broken relationships and restore trust where it has been damaged. Help me to be the kind of person others can count on - loyal, honest, and caring. Teach me to love others as God loves me, with patience, kindness, and forgiveness. St. Anthony, bring the peace of Christ into all my relationships. Amen.
days.reflection: St. Anthony's preaching often focused on how people should treat one another with love and respect. He reminds us that our relationships with others are a reflection of our relationship with God, and that peace in our families contributes to peace in the world.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, help me to build loving, peaceful relationships with my family and friends. Teach me to be an instrument of God's love in their lives.
days.scripture: "Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins." - 1 Peter 4:8

days.title: Day 9: Growing in Holiness
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: St. Anthony, model of holiness and faithful servant of God, as I conclude this novena, I ask you to help me grow in holiness and to become the person God wants me to be. You achieved great sanctity in a short life by giving yourself completely to God and serving His people with love. Help me to follow your example of prayer, study, and service. Inspire me to take my relationship with God seriously and to make choices that draw me closer to Him. Help me to develop the virtues you exemplified - humility, charity, obedience, and zeal for souls. When I am tempted to sin or to neglect my spiritual duties, strengthen my resolve to choose what is right. Guide me in developing a deeper prayer life and a greater love for Sacred Scripture. Help me to see my daily work and responsibilities as opportunities to serve God and grow in holiness. Most of all, help me to trust in God's mercy when I fail and to begin again with renewed commitment. I want to spend my life, as you did, helping others to know and love God. St. Anthony, pray for me throughout my life, that I may persevere in faith and reach the happiness of heaven where I hope to thank you personally for your intercession. Amen.
days.reflection: The greatest 'miracle' St. Anthony can work in our lives is to help us become saints. All his other interventions - finding lost objects, healing illnesses, solving problems - are meant to lead us closer to God and to help us focus on what truly matters: our eternal salvation.
days.intention_prayer: St. Anthony, help me to become holy as you did. Guide me on the path to sainthood and help me to serve God faithfully all my life.
days.scripture: "Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect." - Matthew 5:48

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to St. Anthony of Padua
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time, but many people pray it on Tuesdays (traditionally associated with St. Anthony) or in preparation for his feast day on June 13. It is customary to make a small donation to charity when prayers are answered through St. Anthony's intercession. Many people also keep a picture or statue of St. Anthony in their homes as a reminder of his protection and care.
